import json

items = {{$json}}
if isinstance(items, dict):
    items = items.get('results', items.get('data', items.get('items', [items])))
if not isinstance(items, list):
    items = [items]

seen_urls = set()
seen_keys = set()
normalized = []

for job in items:
    company = job.get('companyName') or job.get('company') or job.get('author') or ''
    title = job.get('title') or job.get('jobTitle') or job.get('name') or ''
    location = job.get('location') or job.get('locations') or job.get('city') or ''
    url = job.get('url') or job.get('jobUrl') or job.get('link') or job.get('guid') or ''
    jd = job.get('description') or job.get('body') or job.get('content') or job.get('text') or ''
    source = job.get('source', 'scraped')
    posted = job.get('postedDate') or job.get('date') or job.get('pubDate') or ''

    # Dedup by URL
    norm_url = url.strip().lower().rstrip('/')
    if norm_url and norm_url in seen_urls:
        continue
    if norm_url:
        seen_urls.add(norm_url)

    # Dedup by company+title+location
    key = f"{company.lower().strip()}|{title.lower().strip()}|{location.lower().strip()}"
    if key in seen_keys:
        continue
    seen_keys.add(key)

    normalized.append({
        'company': company,
        'title': title,
        'location': location,
        'experience': job.get('experienceRequired') or job.get('experience') or '',
        'job_url': url,
        'jd': jd,
        'source': source or 'scraped',
        'posted_date': posted,
        'discovered_date': '{{$now.toISOString()}}'
    })

return normalized

Return valid JSON only with: experience_status (PASS/REJECT/REVIEW/MISSING_DATA), experience_reason, role_match (0-100), skill_match (0-100), location_match (0-100), tweak_level (0-100), overall_score (0-100), matched_skills, missing_skills, recommended (bool), why_this_job. import json

items = {{$json}}
results = []
weights = {
    'role_weight': 0.25,
    'skill_weight': 0.4,
    'location_weight': 0.15,
    'tweak_weight': 0.2
}

for item in items:
    analysis_text = item.get('choices', [{}])[0].get('message', {}).get('content', '{}')
    try:
        analysis = json.loads(analysis_text)
    except:
        analysis = {}

    if analysis.get('experience_status') == 'REJECT':
        analysis['overall_score'] = -1
        analysis['recommended'] = False

    results.append({
        'company': item.get('company', ''),
        'title': item.get('title', ''),
        'location': item.get('location', ''),
        'job_url': item.get('job_url', ''),
        'experience': item.get('experience', ''),
        'experience_status': analysis.get('experience_status', 'MISSING_DATA'),
        'experience_reason': analysis.get('experience_reason', ''),
        'role_match': analysis.get('role_match', 0),
        'skill_match': analysis.get('skill_match', 0),
        'location_match': analysis.get('location_match', 50),
        'tweak_level': analysis.get('tweak_level', 50),
        'overall_score': analysis.get('overall_score', 0),
        'recommended': analysis.get('recommended', False),
        'why_this_job': analysis.get('why_this_job', ''),
        'matched_skills': analysis.get('matched_skills', []),
        'missing_skills': analysis.get('missing_skills', []),
        'review_required': analysis.get('review_required', False)
    })

# Sort: PASS first, then by overall_score desc, then by tweak_level asc
passing = [r for r in results if r.get('experience_status') == 'PASS']
others = [r for r in results if r.get('experience_status') != 'PASS']
passing.sort(key=lambda r: (-r.get('overall_score', 0), r.get('tweak_level', 0), -r.get('skill_match', 0)))

sorted_results = passing + others
return sorted_results[:100]
